<div id="post-2078" class="post-2078 page type-page status-publish hentry">
    <div class="grid-100 mobile-grid-100 tablet-grid-100">
        <div class="entry-content clearfix">    
            <div class="wpb-content-wrapper"><section id="ut-section-6acd11b665e38" data-vc-full-width="true" data-vc-full-width-init="false" data-cursor-skin="global" class="vc_section ut-vc-120 vc_section-has-no-fill ut-section-6acd11b665e43"><div id="ut-row-6acd11b6896c2" data-vc-full-width="true" data-vc-full-width-init="false" class="vc_row wpb_row vc_row-fluid vc_column-gap-0 ut-row-6acd11b6896d1" ><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-12" ><div id="ut_inner_column_6acd11b6920fd" class="vc_column-inner " ><div class="wpb_wrapper"><div class="wpb_content_element "><style type="text/css"></style><header id="ut_header_6acd11b692554" class="section-header  ut-no-title-linebreak-mobile ut-no-lead-linebreak-mobile pt-style-1 header-center header-tablet-center header-mobile-center"><h1 data-title="Guesthouse Gallery"  data-responsive-font="section_title" data-responsive-font-settings="{&quot;base-font-size&quot;:&quot;40&quot;,&quot;font-size-unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;font-size&quot;:{&quot;desktop_large&quot;:&quot;40&quot;},&quot;base-line-height&quot;:&quot;90&quot;,&quot;line-height-unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;line-height&quot;:{&quot;desktop_large&quot;:&quot;90&quot;},&quot;base-letter-spacing&quot;:&quot;global&quot;}" class="bklyn-divider-styles bklyn-divider-style-1 section-title "><span>Guesthouse Gallery</span></h1></header></div><div class="vc_icon_element vc_icon_element-outer vc_do_icon vc_icon_element-align-center"><div class="vc_icon_element-inner vc_icon_element-color-black vc_icon_element-size-lg vc_icon_element-style- vc_icon_element-background-color-grey" ><span class="vc_icon_element-icon BklynIcons-Bad-3" ></span></div></div><style type="text/css"></style><p id="ut_custom_heading6acd11b694b76" data-responsive-font="p" data-responsive-font-settings="{&quot;base-font-size&quot;:&quot;15&quot;,&quot;font-size-unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;font-size&quot;:{&quot;desktop_large&quot;:&quot;15&quot;},&quot;base-line-height&quot;:&quot;35&quot;,&quot;line-height-unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;line-height&quot;:{&quot;desktop_large&quot;:&quot;35&quot;},&quot;base-letter-spacing&quot;:&quot;global&quot;}" class="ut-custom-heading-module  " ><span class="" ><b>Alvor KiteCenter Guesthouse<b> is located in the center of the village of Alvor, within walking distance of the beach, lagoon, bars and restaurants.<br />
This new place has 5 rooms including 1 Family Room, 1 triple, 2 doubles and 1 suite. Each room has its own bathroom, is nicely and minimally decorated and has a mini bar, satellite tv, wi-fi, air conditioning etc&#8230; The shared kitchen is equipped with everything you might need to prepare your meals. It has a veranda where all our guests can have breakfast together. A nice and cozy communal area.<br />
The house also has access to a beautiful lounge area where you can enjoy some drinks in a secluded indoor garden.<br />
It also features a jacuzzi and a terrace with 360 view where you can see the lagoon, beach and watch the sunset etc.</span></p>

<div class="n2-ss-slider-wrapper-outside" style="grid-template-rows:1fr auto"><div class="n2-ss-slider-wrapper-inside">
